text: The restaurant is run by children. Literal children who must not be over 16. It’s obviously not their fault but they shouldn’t be the only ones working there. They take ages to take your order and then ages to give it to you. I don’t understand why there are no screens to order like in every other European mc Donald’s. Also they don’t give you any receipt or ticket with your order number, and there is no screen showing which orders are being prepared and which ones are ready. Of course this ends with a long waiting time (which is not what you’re looking for at a fast food restaurant!) and cold food. Total disaster
author: Camila Reeb

text: The worst McDonalds I have been to. The burgers were done with zero care - sauce only in some parts of the burger, unevenly distributed toppings. It was like someone just took all ingredients, threw them in a bag and started shaking (Im ofc exagerrating, but honestly not much). What absolutely made the experience complete was how dirty the whole place was. There was trash and spilled drinks all over the place... On the ground, on tables, on chairs, just everywhere. And the bins were all completely full, so you could not even dispose of your own trash properly. Just straight up disgusting
author: Ondřej Košut

text:
Probably the worst McDonald's in the universe. (And beyond)
No water, no milkshakes, no salads, no straws, no juice, no softdrinks without gas, no napkins. After eventually figuring out what was available we ordered 2 cheeseburgers and a quarter pounder menu. After 35 minutes the staff managed to get them done. They forgot the fries, but luckily I was sharp enough to help them remember a menu came with fries.
Get some screens in here, maybe the staff will be able to manage a half empty restaurant on a Wednesday afternoon with the help of some technology available to the rest of the world
author: Tom Heintzberger

text: This place is sorely lacking in efficiency and proper management. Yes, the night shift is always messier due to the pressure, but that does not excuse the general chaos going on at this branch. Management seriously need to reconsider their approach. Waiting over 40 minutes with staff forgetting and mixing up orders etc is not why people go to McDonald's. At the very least, get a flatscreen where customers can check that their order is ready. I'm sure your staff would appreciate that as well rather than screaming numbers at hangry drunks. Thought this was standard these days?!
author: Sebastian Rydberg

text:
One of the worst McDonald's in Europe that I visited. The food was clearly rubbish and not properly prepared, my burger was onto semi-warm as well as fries. But it may happen at busy hours and I assume that Friday near midnight may be this.

But ffs what is wrong with the guests/cleaning service? The place was absolutely dirty, tables were stained, we barely managed to find one that wasn't sticky. And aren't you people taught to clean after yourself when you're done eating? The bin is like 5 meters away and it takes literally 30 seconds to put rubbish there. Shame.
author: Tomasz

text: Worst ever experience at a McDonald’s. First the machine didn’t print my receipt, and I was told to just wait. When no one gave me my order and I told the staff three times of this over a 20 minute time span, I was finally given my order - completely burnt cheeseburger, aswell not even being given the dip that I had paid for. The place was super unclean and gross, the staff overworked and useless at their jobs, and it was utterly chaotic from the time I arrived. I will never come back, and I hope this disgusting place is shut down.
author: William Fihl Vetting

text: The worst McDonald's among McDonald's branches in twenty countries that I've been to! The French fries was a total disaster . Salty and smells and tastes very bad. The worst french fries I've ever had in my entire life. Burger was not even 20% similar to the picture or even half similar to the ones in other branches outside Denmark! Also it's not cheap.I was also shocked how dirty the place was!tables,floor and even chairs!Pay a little more and you can enjoy some nice food courts in Copenhagen.
author: Aria

text: This place is massively understaffed and unorganized. After waiting for 10 minutes in queue, 10 minutes to receive the order I had to wait another 10 to get the missing food, for which I didn't even hear a sorry, just that "it will take a while". It would probably take even longer if I hadn't reminded that I'm still waiting each time a customer got their order with the meal I was expecting. There's also leftover food all over the place. That is far from the McDonald's standard I got used to.
author: Przemysław Pełka

text:
The staff were friendly. Young girl who served us was polite.
The fries were cold, the burger tasted like sawdust rather than beef and the mcflurry was a little warm.
The worst part was the toilet though. There was no toilet roll, it was very dirty, full bins and rubbish on the floor, the taps didn't work in the bathroom either. The place wasn't even busy there is no excuse for a place to be this bad.
Genuinely awful I would recommend avoiding this place
author: Philip Oneill

text: I visited this McDonald in the late Friday evening, inside was moderately crowded with plenty of seating space, but many seats weren't taken by anyone, and I'm not very surprised because unfortunately most of the tables were very dirty and looked like nobody cleaned there for at least a few hours. Food-wise it's hard to go wrong with McDonald, but I've never seen McDonald or any food place that was this dirty before.
author: Maciej Cyranowicz

text: ‼️FOOD POISONED‼️I don't know how to report food poisoning in denmark but I went to see Auroras concert 29 april 2025 (two days ago from now) and I ate one McChicken and I puked my guts out 15 times and missed Aurora. Even the paramedics arrived and I was very disappointed. Still have the receipt so I'm going to try to figure out how to report it for others safety, especially tourists it was a nightmare!
author: Ria-Rebecka Remes

text: Staffed by children. Badly ran. No communication between staff. The franchise owners should stop using child labour. They all look knackered. A simple cheeseburger took 20 mins to make. The sever put the rest of the food on a tray. By the time the burger was done, thay food was cold. You don't expect fine dining at McDonalds but this is possibly the worst one in the world. Good milkshake though.
author: Luke O'Reilly

text: After 30mins in line, they cannot take my credit card, all 3 cards that I have been using for hotel, supermarket, car parking etc. so it is definitely not my card. It was their system issue. In the end we have to pay cash in Euro$ since we do now carry around DKK$. They cannot return the changes in euro$, so do not eat in this place unless you have cash and have a lot of time to wait in line.
author: Elsa Mark

text:
Worst McDonald's I have ever been. Very disorganized, employees rushing and looking completely lost.
Asked for 4 cheese burgers, they gave us 8... Asked for normal size menu, they gave us the larger menu.
Also dirty and very bad atmosphere.

They should review their standards and also install Self-service Kiosks to help manage the mess that goes in this restaurant.
author: Bruno

text: I just stood in line for 40 minutes waiting to order a grov vegetar only to come to the end of the line and be told they don't sell vegetarian burgers there, even if it is on the menu. This makes me so angry and I have wasted almost an hour in a chaotic line. Bad experience and the person helping em was unresponsive and not at all bothered about it.
author: amalia robinson

text:
Very crowded, veeeery long waiting time.
No ketchups given for take away.
There are no self-service machines.
There are no numbers for order given on receipt, nor any screen to display if they are ready. The cashier informs you about your number, then you must wait next to the cash desk to hear anything because it is so loud there.
author: Wojciech Włodarczyk

text: After ordering the salad and other orders they gave us the bag and we come home the salad is not there . We go back they say they ran out of the salad (they are supposedly open till 2 am but they eun out of salad at 11:30 pm what a joke ) and ofcourse they dont redund the money for something that was their own mistake not ours !
author: Peg T

text: Disappointed, printer of machine broken, no receipt, no one responsible to try to help, had to wait in front of the counter and hope to see my menu, arrived 20 minutes later, fries were cold, complained, got new fries which were again cold,as they were already prefilled in the box, but guess no one cares about my feedback
author: Giovanni Staunovo

text: The order took a very long time to prepare, and the fries had already cooled down, all the gas had gone out of the soda, and the burger was not tasty. The staff is unfriendly, the girl did not even say hello and had a dissatisfied face. The seats are dirty, even the backs are sticky. I do NOT recommend this place.
author: Galina Gubina

text: Stopped in for breakfast! Surprise! Surprise! They have no breakfast so we ordered cinnamon rolls and cafe latte.  Both were good however our credit cards didn’t work there and we had only USD. We wound up paying a $10 service charge to pay in USD!  We should have gone somewhere else that took credit cards.
author: Charlene Fransen

text:
Since when has it been okay to cuss and swear as a member of staff to someone that barely spoke a word but waited 30mins for a value meal+double cheese.
Disgusting. Previously worked for a Maccies in the UK and you can see that the 9+ staff were not sticking to procedure and taking it out on the customers.
author: Nicola Morgan

text: it was extremely crowed, no maschines to order were there. we had to wait in line. a girl wo didn’t look a day over the age of 12 was working there. it took ages to get the food. its dirty, the toilet is completely unacceptable. leftover food is lying on the tables. a homeless is sleeping on the floor.
author: Victoria Klein

text: Very upset.  There are no toys for happy sweet, the potatoes are too salty, the cheeseburgers are tasteless, there is a constant squeak from the kitchen, which is not very pleasant.  Staff in very dirty clothes, served very very long.  I'm from Ukraine, and I've never seen the worst McDonald's.
author: Mariia Kovalova

text:
They tried to steal my friend’s bag, had to ask 3 different employees to try to get it back, manager flat out denied having it.
Finally a kind waitress went in and got it for us.
The ordering machine we went to wasn’t working, overall it was dirty and the service was awful.
author: Balázs Kóka

text:
15 minute wait

bad quality, old burgers. i just bought 2 big burgers, they were hard and old.

i then got 2 new burgers from the heating rack. same experience. see attached picture for an idea of the quality of macdonalds food u get here (i love macdonalds)
author: Mikkel Vester

text: The place is very dirty. Outside is full of garbage on the ground from their bins. They mistaken my order. The Coca Cola was warm. And there was no soap at the bathroom. I consider that McDonalds should impose stricter quality control over their franchises.
author: Cld Fldn

text: Waited 25 minutes for a single breakfast sandwich. Wasn't informed of the delay when ordering, wasn't apologised to when it eventually turned up. Nearly missed my boat tour because of them. Avoid. Especially if you're looking for fast food
author: Stephen Nicholas

text:
The wifi here is the only thing that’s working well,
but the big tasty is dry as hell.
The veggie burgers on the menu are a lie,
and the nasty toilet makes me wanna die.
The 14y old worker forgot my fries,
this $h*t ain‘t worth the price⚡️
author: G Meier

text: McDisgusting, this place was filthy, all of the tables covered in rubbish, cheese sauce all over the floor of the restaurant and you had to paddle in urine when visiting the toilet!
author: Martyn King

text: Stood at the counter for 20 minutes waiting to pay for my food but no one came to help out of all the McDonald's I've been at this was the most useless one...go somewhere else
author: Vilde Uriansrud

text: The worsest I have ever been, and I have visit a lot!!! Over whole Europe it is catastrophic. Crows, automated machines arent working, payment with carda is problem. Omg???
author: Prof. dr Komlen Lalovic

text: This is the first time I had very bad experience with McD. No veggies in burger n has to ask in the counter for it. Fries are not fried well and nuggets too. Pathetic!!
author: Shankar MP

text:
Waitet half an hour for 2 cheese burgers. It's was not even busy, when I got it the food was cold good job.
Never coming back to this McDonald's shame
author: Samir Elazemouri

text:
No Gluten free food as promised on the Website.
The servants are some 12 year olds, at least they behave like that.
It’s crowded, not enough seats etc

text: Place is too dirty and customer service is was too bad they are so rude and they didn’t gove water to my child after i purchased the combo meal
author: Ehsan Rahbaran

text: Absolute WORST burger in CPH.  If they served this crap in country of origin,  the US, the store would be closed  asap and owner fired.

text: The cleanliness was terrible. What kind of restroom condition is this?? Does this branch even have a manager to check these things?
author: Mo

text: Music is nasty and way too loud. Alarms in kitchen blare non stop. Their veg burger tastes awful. BK veg burger is MUCH better
author: Joe Patroni

text: Alrhough it is well known Copenhagen McDonalds should have gluten free option, on my request the men by cashier said “no”
author: Jani N

text: Such a bad conversation with people. You just ask question and they don’t respect you, yell at you without listening.

text: Halfbaked chips. Cola zero without bubbles. Garbage bins full. Lonf waiting time. Wrong food at first.

text: Very slow, quite dirty, Nice but stressed workers. My burger was just thrown together in a hurry.

text:
I order 12 pics of hot wings but got only 3 pics when I checked at home
Such a poor service

text: No free ketchup. How I’m i supposed to eat my fries? By paying 15Kr extra?

text: Worst McDonald’s ever. Dirty, cold food, no service at all.

text: One of the worst McDonald's I've been to. Filthy and dirty.
